$comment: Charges past the plan (AGL-3671): the console's metered estimate and overage captions, from the same counters, quotas and rates. Grammar: docs/mobile/native-architecture.md §13.

screens.title: Past your plan
screens.subtitle: What usage beyond the plan costs this month

derive.name: comp
derive.when: data.org.entitlements.planComp.plan != free && data.org.entitlements.planComp.plan && !data.org.subscription.status || data.org.entitlements.planComp.plan != free && data.org.entitlements.planComp.plan && data.org.subscription.status == canceled,unpaid,incomplete,incomplete_expired

blocks.text: Your plan’s storage, bandwidth and form submissions are included caps, not meters — no usage charges. What is used is under Usage.

blocks.title: Estimated charges, month to date ({now.month})
blocks.footer: Only usage beyond your plan’s included storage, bandwidth and form submissions is metered, at our cost + 30% after card fees.

rows.label: Estimated
rows.value: {round((max(0, (data.hostMedia.*.bytes + data.orgMedia.bytes?) / 1073741824 - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.storagePerHostMb / 1024)) * const.billed.storagePerGbMonth + max(0, (data.siteTraffic.*.monthPageViews + data.usage.monthPageViews?) - (data.ent.quotas.bandwidthGb * 1073741824 / 1037107.2)) * const.billed.perPageView + max(0, (data.hostForms.*.[@now.month]) - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.formSubmissionsPerMonth)) * const.billed.perFormSubmission) * 100) / 100:usd}

rows.label: Storage past the allowance
rows.value: {max(0, (data.hostMedia.*.bytes + data.orgMedia.bytes?) / 1073741824 - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.storagePerHostMb / 1024)):number} GB · {max(0, (data.hostMedia.*.bytes + data.orgMedia.bytes?) / 1073741824 - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.storagePerHostMb / 1024)) * const.billed.storagePerGbMonth:usd}

blocks.title: Estimated charges, month to date ({now.month})
blocks.footer: Only usage beyond your plan’s included storage, bandwidth and form submissions is metered, at our cost + 30% after card fees.

rows.label: Estimated
rows.value: {round((max(0, (data.hostMedia.*.bytes) / 1073741824 - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.storagePerHostMb / 1024)) * const.billed.storagePerGbMonth + max(0, (data.siteTraffic.*.monthPageViews + data.usage.monthPageViews?) - (data.ent.quotas.bandwidthGb * 1073741824 / 1037107.2)) * const.billed.perPageView + max(0, (data.hostForms.*.[@now.month]) - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.formSubmissionsPerMonth)) * const.billed.perFormSubmission) * 100) / 100:usd}

rows.label: Storage past the allowance
rows.value: {max(0, (data.hostMedia.*.bytes) / 1073741824 - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.storagePerHostMb / 1024)):number} GB · {max(0, (data.hostMedia.*.bytes) / 1073741824 - (max(1, data.ent.quotas.hostLimit) * data.ent.quotas.storagePerHostMb / 1024)) * const.billed.storagePerGbMonth:usd}

blocks.text: Storage includes {data.orgMedia.bytes / 1073741824:number} GB in your organization library, which shares this allowance with your sites.

{data.orgMedia.bytes / 1073741824:number} GB in your organization library shares the storage allowance with your sites. It is measured but not yet billed, so uploads into it stop at the allowance for now.

Page views include {(data.siteTraffic.*.monthMediaBandwidthBytes + data.usage.monthMediaBandwidthBytes?) / 1073741824:number} GB of video, audio and files served from your media library, which count 1.6x toward bandwidth because serving them costs more than serving pages.

Records overage: {max(0, data.contacts.count + data.companies.count + data.deals.count - data.ent.quotas.contactsPerHost):number} over the included band at ${const.pricing[@data.ent.plan].extraContactsUsdPer1k}/1,000 — ≈{round(max(0, data.contacts.count + data.companies.count + data.deals.count - data.ent.quotas.contactsPerHost) / 1000 * const.pricing[@data.ent.plan].extraContactsUsdPer1k * 100) / 100:dollars} if your CRM ends the month at this size.

API overage: {max(0, data.api.count - data.ent.quotas.apiRequestsPerMonth):number} requests over the included band at {const.pricing[@data.ent.plan].extraApiRequestsUsdPer1k:dollars}/1,000 — ≈{round(max(0, data.api.count - data.ent.quotas.apiRequestsPerMonth) / 1000 * const.pricing[@data.ent.plan].extraApiRequestsUsdPer1k * 100) / 100:dollars} on this month's invoice.

{max(0, data.emails[@now.month] - data.ent.quotas.emailSendsPerMonth):number} emails over your included {data.ent.quotas.emailSendsPerMonth:number} this month at {const.pricing[@data.ent.plan].extraEmailSendsUsdPer1k:dollars}/1,000 — ≈{round(max(0, data.emails[@now.month] - data.ent.quotas.emailSendsPerMonth) / 1000 * const.pricing[@data.ent.plan].extraEmailSendsUsdPer1k * 100) / 100:dollars} on this month's invoice. Transactional mail — receipts, invites, password resets — is never refused at the cap, so it is what takes an organization past the band.
Metered charges settle on the same invoice as your monthly subscription.
Your subscription is annual, so usage accrues across the year and settles on your renewal invoice.
